ov: كل شيء عن إيف (All About Eve) فيلم أمريكي إنتاج سنة 1950 من بطولة بيت دافيس بدور مارجو شانينج، إضافة للنجمة مارلين مونرو
plotEn:
At the Sarah Siddons Award ceremony honoring rising actress Eve Harrington, narration from acerbic theatre critic Addison DeWitt introduces the attendees and hints that there is more to Eve's story.
The previous October, Karen Richards, wife of playwright Lloyd Richards, notices Eve has repeatedly hovered outside the theater where aging Broadway star Margo Channing is starring in a play written by Lloyd. When Karen introduces Eve to Margo as her devoted fan, Eve tells Margo, Karen, and Lloyd that she followed Margo's last theatrical tour from San Francisco to New York City. She relates her impoverished childhood and the loss of her husband during World War II. Moved by Eve's story, Margo takes her into her home as her assistant. Eve quickly manipulates her way into Margo's life as both secretary and adoring fan.
Having just turned forty, Margo is concerned about her romantic relationship with the play’s director, Bill Simpson, eight years her junior, who is directing a film in California. Without telling Margo, Eve arranges a midnight long-distance phone call from Margo to Bill on his birthday. Eve hopes the unexpected call will show Bill that Margo forgot his birthday, while Eve sent her own greeting. Realizing Eve set her up, Margo asks producer Max Fabian to hire Eve at his office; instead of being distanced, Eve becomes Margo's understudy without Margo's knowledge.
